item.title: Novo Nordisk to cut U.S. list prices for Wegovy and Ozempic
item.description: Novo Nordisk said it will lower list prices in the United States for drugs based on semaglutide. The changes apply to the weight-loss drug Wegovy, the diabetes drug Ozempic, and the pill-based diabetes drug Rybelsus. All three drugs will have a new list price of $675 per month, or about 4,280 DKK. The new prices […]

item.title: From refusing an arranged marriage in her home country to facing unemployment, becoming an entrepreneur, and eventually working in a lab: the journey of a Nepalese woman in Denmark
item.description: After arriving in 2009, Manisha Singh navigated language barriers, career changes, and cultural shifts to build a life she now calls home.

item.title: Denmark and 18 nations condemn Israel’s West Bank moves
item.description: Denmark and 18 other countries issued a joint statement strongly condemning Israel’s recent actions in the West Bank. item.title: Meta deal sends US chipmaker shares soaring
item.description: AMD shares rose over six percent following an agreement to sell millions of AI chips to Meta. item.title: Mette F. calls Orbán “pro-Russian” and “anti-European”
item.description: During a visit to Ukraine on the four-year anniversary of the Russian invasion, Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen criticized Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán for blocking a 20th sanctions package and a 90 billion euro loan. item.title: Red-Greens demand wealth tax as a condition to back a left government

item.title: Danish Defense Minister open to nuclear talks on Danish soil
item.description: Danish Defense Minister Troels Lund Poulsen is open to discussing Danish co-financing or the storage of nuclear weapons on Danish soil. This would involve reconsidering Denmark’s 70-year ban on such weapons due to the current security situation.
